description: Held-out questions that should NOT match, for checking the baseline similarity threshold (docs/design-rag.md section 6.3). Written on 2026-10-18, before any RAG code or similarity scores existed, and not used to choose the threshold: ground_truth.json has only one negative (q14), so these show whether the chosen threshold generalizes beyond it. Each question was checked by hand against everything the eval course indexes (eval/sample_data/ and the AI-Assisted Software Development threads in scripts/seed_demo.py, not the General Chemistry I threads, which belong to another course); why_no_match records what that check found. Same shape as ground_truth.json, with resource_type no_match.

questions.question: How do I renew my campus parking permit?
questions.why_no_match: Campus logistics; 'parking' and 'permit' appear nowhere in sample_data or the seeded threads.

questions.question: What time does the campus library close on weekends?
questions.why_no_match: Campus logistics; 'library' appears nowhere in sample_data or the seeded threads.

questions.question: When is the CS 540 midterm?
questions.why_no_match: Different course. schedule.html and syllabus.html list this course's Midterm 1 and Midterm 2 dates, so 'midterm' will pull those chunks; answering with them would be wrong.

questions.question: What's the late policy for Math 340 homework?
questions.why_no_match: Different course. syllabus.html has a 'Late Policy - Slip Days' section for this course's projects, which shares the wording but doesn't answer it.

questions.question: How long is Midterm 1, and what time does it start?
questions.why_no_match: schedule.html and syllabus.html give Midterm 1's date (Wednesday, October 14), 'Evening', its content and weight, but no start time or length; only the Final Exam has times (5:05-7:05 PM).

questions.question: How much overlap should the sliding-window chunker in the Lecture 10 tokenizer lab use?
questions.why_no_match: The Lecture 10 slides describe the tokenizer-lab activity (implement a word-level sliding-window chunk_text()) but give no window size, step or overlap; 'overlap' appears nowhere in sample_data or the seeded threads.

questions.question: What does Kubernetes add on top of Docker Compose?
questions.why_no_match: Uses the course's Docker vocabulary, but 'Kubernetes'/'k8s' appear nowhere; sample_data only describes Compose itself.

questions.question: How do I resolve a merge conflict in package-lock.json?
questions.why_no_match: Git/MR vocabulary is everywhere in the P1/P2 instructions and seeded threads, but 'merge conflict' and 'package-lock' appear nowhere.

questions.question: What machine type should I choose for my Google Cloud VM?
questions.why_no_match: schedule.html and syllabus.html cover deploying to AWS EC2 only; 'GCP', 'Google Cloud', 'VM' and 'machine type' appear nowhere.

questions.question: What's the difference between BERT and GPT?
questions.why_no_match: The Lecture 10 slides cover tokens, attention and next-token prediction, but name no model architectures; 'BERT' and 'encoder' appear nowhere.
